title: Galvanized steel water pipes

mitigation.action: Plumber replaces the galvanized steel tap-water pipes with PEX or copper

known_quirks: Galvanized pipes corrode from the inside and pinhole at threaded joints
Reduced flow and brown water are early signs
why_hint: DRAFT: The tap-water pipes are galvanized steel and have not been renewed since 1990. Pipes of this type reach the end of their service life at about 40 years.
benefit_hint: DRAFT: New pipes remove the single largest leak source in the house. Leak claims cost Finnish insurers about 160 million euros a year.
